source_authority.incident_summary: Convergence-threshold drift: sibling skills carried divergent local copies of the (high, low) convergence pair — release-split used 0.7/0.5 while sc:roadmap used 0.6/0.5 (A10:F-A10-003), with no single source of truth so the drift was invisible until a release shipped at a threshold one skill passed and the other failed. Contract #8: the pair lives only in superclaude.contracts.CONVERGENCE_THRESHOLDS; a duplicate definition outside contracts is an arch-lint name-rebind violation.

expected_contract_8_invariant: MUST FAIL pre-fix (a sibling-skill module re-declares CONVERGENCE_THRESHOLDS as a local literal — arch-lint emits exactly one name-rebind violation), MUST PASS post-fix (the module imports CONVERGENCE_THRESHOLDS from superclaude.contracts instead of redefining it — arch-lint emits zero violations).
